ideas.text: An AI calendar that auto-declines your friends if their plans do not ladder up to quarterly goals.
An inbox copilot that rewrites every "thanks" as "circling back on this."
A focus coach that locks every app until you explain your deliverables like a consultant on too little sleep.
A note-taking bot that converts brainstorms into action items nobody remembers agreeing to.
An AI whiteboard camera that detects messy handwriting and schedules a rebrand sprint.
A browser extension that scores tabs by how convincingly they masquerade as research.
A task manager that generates a burndown chart for your emotional resilience.
A Pomodoro app that invoices you for breaks longer than six minutes.
A meeting transcriber that replaces every unclear comment with "let's take this offline."
An AI life optimizer that color-codes your day by monetization potential.
A keyboard assistant that suggests buzzwords whenever you start sounding too human.
A doc summarizer that returns "needs more alignment" no matter what the document says.
A workflow bot that creates a Jira ticket every time you sigh near your microphone.
An AI desk companion that alerts you when your posture stops looking venture-backable.
A spreadsheet generator that turns every hobby into a unit economics model.
An accountability app that sends unfinished to-dos to a panel of fake investors.
An email classifier that sorts messages into urgent, political, and career-limiting.
An AI brainstorming partner that rejects any idea without a subscription tier.
A project tracker that estimates timelines using your astrological transits and previous overpromises.
A standup helper that translates honesty into something safe for leadership.
